A friendly reminder

Help us keep the pools clean

Please follow the resort's swimwear policy to help conserve water and maintain a clean swimming environment.

Proper swimwear is required

Regular clothes such as T-shirts, jeans, and non-swimwear shorts are not allowed in the pool. Please wear proper swimming attire, such as swimsuits, swimming trunks, or rash guards.

Thank you for helping conserve water and maintain pool cleanliness. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.
